research.title: Kill Install Scripts: A Post-keyv Hardening Playbook for npm, pnpm and CI
research.whyTrending: Direct practical follow-up to the keyv worm - the attack only worked because preinstall runs by default. Concrete controls exist and almost nobody has them on: ignore-scripts, pnpm onlyBuiltDependencies allowlists, minimumReleaseAge cooldowns, lockfile pinning, npm audit signatures, isolated CI runners with scoped tokens. Turns a scary headline into a checklist a team can ship in an afternoon.
